past_2_weeks.headline: Major AI-Driven Surge Wipes Out Short-Term Institutional Churning.

indexes.name: Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC)
indexes.action: Accumulation Day. The tech-heavy index roared higher as artificial intelligence demand confidence was heavily reinforced. Trading volume surged noticeably above the previous day's level, marking a clear institutional accumulation event. Short-term distribution days dropped to 3 as older distribution faded.

indexes.name: S&P 500 (.INX)
indexes.action: Accumulation Day. Following a flat, volume-churned session on Wednesday, the benchmark index moved solidly back above short-term technical clusters. Distribution Day Count stands at 3.

indexes.name: Invesco S&P 500 Equal Weight (RSP)
indexes.action: Advanced +0.35%. Steady growth, though it underperformed the market-cap weighted version. This indicates that block institutional buying remains aggressively concentrated within massive enterprise and tech-heavy infrastructure positions rather than trailing smaller cyclicals.

indexes.name: Direxion Nasdaq-100 Equal Weight (QQQE)
indexes.action: Up +0.65%. Reclaimed technical momentum as a rising tide in hardware components pulled equal-weight tech upwards.

sector_led_breakouts.action: Exploded +8.0%. It sliced out of a tight base consolidation pattern, printing multi-million share block institutional volume (+160% above daily averages) following a 70% forward guidance expansion.
Rocketed +5.5%. This moves it decisively out of a late-stage flat base layout, supported by heavy enterprise software fund inflows.
Cleared an aggressive handle pivot zone on +11% volume surge. It is leading the vital cybersecurity complex into fresh high-ground terrain.

divergent_breakouts.action: Surged +10.71%. It triggered a high-volume base breakout, flashing a major Relative Strength (RS) line push towards 52-week highs despite ongoing structural stagnation across retail and consumer discretionary sectors.
Skyrocketed +10.41% out of a deep rounding configuration base on explosive volume. It strongly diverged from secondary components and telecom hardware laggards.

past_2_weeks.headline: Mixed Signals: Quiet Rebound Followed by Disguised Churning.

sector_led_breakouts.action: Surged +9.35%, breaking cleanly out of an institutional base on an AI infrastructure partnership.
Exploded +14.36%, clearing an active accumulation consolidation pattern on major volume tracking over its 50-DMA.

divergent_breakouts.action: Jumped +4.9% out of a flat base on a sharp volume expansion, outperforming an otherwise mixed and heavy semiconductor index sector.
Rallied +8.17%, driving to fresh technical highs on legislative tailwinds while broader financial and small-cap sectors languished.
